consolidatedTrackers.note: Per-lane children closed 2026-07-05; detailed execution truth stays in this hub. PRD-687 is the canonical plan-hub parent mirror because plan-hub supports one parent issue; PRD-691 remains the active September needs app tracker.

notes: Vocabulary is Need, never problem — code and copy alike (decision #1).
Four EAS schemas (Need, NeedSignal, NeedStatus, FundingAttribution); commitments stay module-native (CP decision-register addendum #28).
EAS is never indexed by Envio: status derivation is an app-side join of easscan reads and Envio commitment entities carrying needUID.
Need moderation (none/acknowledged/merged/hidden/declined) and progress (open/committed/in-progress/addressed) are separate axes; retraction leaves only a content-free lineage tombstone.
The needUID commitment field was amended into the CP contract-spec on 2026-07-04, before the August build, so it ships in the initial deploy.

A Need is a problem paired with a desired outcome and has no kind. Request/Offer is commitment direction only. NeedStatus domains and commitment domains are optional arrays; DomainImpact commitments require 1-4 unique domain/action pairs.

The selected join-request architecture is a minimal encrypted garden-scoped service queue inside the existing Garden Manage Members dialog; the membership-queue slice remains manually blocked until RESR-64 accepts the proposed retention, EIP-6492/auth, encryption/key-owner, recovery, abuse, cost, and operator-handoff record.
FundingAttribution displays once per verified (needUID, chainId, txHash, rail); mergedIntoNeedUID is typed separately from noteCID.

packages/community is an independent PWA at community.greengoods.app and local port 3010; client and Community consume prerequisite shared runtime/auth/offline/install/update/error/shell foundations but retain separate app identities.
No claim flow, no leaderboards, no funding-ranked boards, no per-need escrow, no push notifications; the gathering is the notification layer.
status.json is authoritative; branch names are automation signals.
.plans/ is the durable lane-level execution truth; Linear is the parent-only roadmap and coordination mirror, not a 1:1 lane mirror.

Linear was reconciled and live-re-read on 2026-07-10: project/milestones, PRD-687/691/695/696, PRD-682/683, canceled-child supersession notes, and the new RESR-64 engagement-model document all match the parent-only plan contract.
